maintainer_override.basis: Pre-1.0 v0.3.7 is approved by the release owner for the exact public candidate after hardware-backed web-flasher qualification across 50 content-addressed observations covering macOS, Linux, Windows, seven board families, both T-Echo foundations, Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari fallback. The exhaustive schema-5 CLI and injected-failure matrix is waived only for 0.3.7; no unperformed scenario or Railway qualification is claimed.
